name: sharegpt-desktop
description: ShareGPT desktop client with built-in messaging and embedded ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude web access (Gemini/Claude optional).
author: Sjeary

scripts.test: npm run test:main && npm --prefix src/renderer-next test
scripts.dev: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs all && npm exec -- electron .
scripts.dev:sender: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs sender && npm exec -- electron . --mode=sender
scripts.dev:receiver: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs receiver && npm exec -- electron . --mode=receiver
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs all --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --win portable
scripts.dist:win:sender: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs sender --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --win nsis --config build.sender.json
scripts.dist:win:receiver: node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs receiver --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --win portable --config build.receiver.json
scripts.dist:win:split: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs sender --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --win portable --config build.sender.json && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs receiver --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --win portable --config build.receiver.json
scripts.dist:win:installer: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs all --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:release: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs all --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --win nsis -c.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs sender --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --mac --config build.sender.json
scripts.dist:mac:sender:local: npm run build:next && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs sender --required && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm exec -- electron-builder --mac dir --config build.sender.json -c.mac.notarize=false -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false && bash scripts/sign-local-macos.sh release_sender/mac-arm64/ShareGPT.app
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs all --required && npm exec -- electron-builder --linux AppImage
